'''Draknus''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]] who resided on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he managed a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] track in [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] with his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[RC-1Z]], [[RC-2X]] and [[RC-3T]].<ref name="SWG:PR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> fellow swooper [[An'Kwee]] introduced to Draknus a spacer who wished to gain trust from Mos Entha swoop racers. The aim of the spacer was to retrieve a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] [[Motivator/Legends|motivator]] that was previously used by a deceased [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot. After the spacer successfully achieved all of Draknus's races, An'Kwee agreed to help the spacer in the search.<ref name="SWG:PR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Draknus was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Draknus was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
